test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Touts cheat tourists so now they are careful.

options.text: Tourists were cheated by touts so now they are careful.
Tourists is cheated by touts so now they are careful.
Tourists are cheated by touts so now they are careful.
Tourists are being cheated by touts so now they are careful.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****Tourists are cheated by touts so now they are careful.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **active voice.** As per the question we have to change it into** passive voice.**
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + infinitive + Object (Active voice)
 
• **Subject (objective case) + to be + past participle + Object (subjective case) (Passive voice)**
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *The grocer sells fresh vegetables. (Active voice)*
 
• *Fresh vegetables are sold by the grocer. (Passive voice)*
 
 
 
• The **subject **of the given sentence is ‘touts’.
 
• The **object **of the given sentence is ‘tourists’.
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• **cheat **will be changed to **are cheated**.
 
• Correct sentence - **Tourists are cheated by touts so now they are careful.**
